data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 opposes the panel but ignores the problem's explicit request to identify evidence within a single evaluation that distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance. Its countercondition for an exhaustive checklist is also self-undermining: if the checklist can be exhaustive and purely algorithmic, the 'pattern matching' objection stops applying and the claim of fundamental inferiority collapses for that entire class of verifiable-outcome tasks, yet the target offers no boundary test to separate that regime from the edge-case regime.
